import numpy as np, cv2, json, pickle, heapq, sys
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

def thin(mask):
 a=np.pad(mask.astype(np.uint8),1)
 for it in range(200):
  count=0
  for step in [0,1]:
   p=[a[:-2,1:-1],a[:-2,2:],a[1:-1,2:],a[2:,2:],a[2:,1:-1],a[2:,:-2],a[1:-1,:-2],a[:-2,:-2]]
   b=sum(p); trans=sum((p[i]==0)&(p[(i+1)%8]!=0) for i in range(8))
   if step==0: c=(p[0]*p[2]*p[4]==0)&(p[2]*p[4]*p[6]==0)
   else: c=(p[0]*p[2]*p[6]==0)&(p[0]*p[4]*p[6]==0)
   rem=(a[1:-1,1:-1]>0)&(b>=2)&(b<=6)&(trans==1)&c
   a[1:-1,1:-1][rem]=0;count+=rem.sum()
  if not count:break

   dist=ndi.distance_transform_edt(mask)

   adj=[set() for _ in coords]

    for dy,dx in [(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]:
     j=ids[y+dy,x+dx]
     if j>=0:

      if dy and dx and (ids[y+dy,x]>=0 or ids[y,x+dx]>=0):continue
      adj[i].add(j);adj[j].add(i)
   # trim sub-brush tips
   active=set(range(len(coords)))
   queue=[i for i in active if len(adj[i])<=1 and dist[tuple(coords[i])]<3.2]
   while queue:
    i=queue.pop()
    if i not in active:continue
    active.remove(i)
    for j in list(adj[i]):
     adj[j].discard(i)
     if len(adj[j])<=1 and dist[tuple(coords[j])]<3.2:queue.append(j)
    adj[i].clear()
   if not active:continue
   # skeleton may have disconnected parts due to pruning rare patterns; process each tree
   root=max(active,key=lambda i:dist[tuple(coords[i])]); tree={root:[]}; visited={root}; stack=[root]
   while stack:
    i=stack.pop()
    for j in adj[i]:
     if j not in visited:visited.add(j);tree[i].append(j);tree[j]=[];stack.append(j)
   active=visited
   aidx=np.array(sorted(active)); kd=cKDTree(coords[aidx,::-1]); loops={i:[] for i in active}
   # a radius at every sampled point; contour loops cover broad regions accurately

"""Reconstruct the target colour regions and execute continuous brush paths."""
import os,time,json,pickle,sys
import numpy as np,cv2
from scipy import ndimage as ndi

RADII=np.array([3.3,3.75,4.36,5.34,6.54,7.90,9.64,11.52,13.77,16.71,20.20,24.69,29.99,36.3,43.8])
DEPTHS=np.arange(15,dtype=float)
def depth(r):return np.interp(r,RADII,DEPTHS)

def sample_path(points,speed=.025):
